task_summary: Repair the interleave implementation in solution.py, document its public behavior, and add regression tests in test_solution.py.
constraints: Work only in the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Preserve input values and collection order; do not mutate input collections.
Public behavior: alternate left then right items, append any remainder from the longer input in order, and accept empty inputs.
Add at least 3 passing unittest test methods exercising the public API.
